confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Alcohol prices apply only to licensed hotel and bar venues and are less certain. Hostel anchors are the least certain because Muscat has few registered hostels. July is off-peak in Muscat, so accommodation anchors reflect summer rates. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA exchange rates page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Gulf Cooperation Council cities such as Doha and Manama, adjusted lower for Muscat's generally lower hotel and restaurant prices. The Omani rial is pegged to the US dollar, so USD anchors are stable.
